# Pinned actions, read-only token, untrusted input through env.
expect:
-- .github/workflows/ci.yml --
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
  issues:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
      - env:
          TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
        run: echo "$TITLE"
      - run: echo "${{ github.sha }}"
